title: Tuyết đêm
about: Round x10, for sleep with improvised melodies (style ngu-ngon), as the user asked to go on ("ok chúng ta hãy tiếp tục sáng tác nhạc"), on the sounds the user liked most: snow falling at night: the old music box improvising slowly, soft high glass glinting now and then, the pad and a far choir. No drums, plucked string or organ. An original piece; its melody made up by the improviser in dark/ambient.py.
